params.code: local w = Scene.FindEntityByName('Walker'); local function clearance(bone) local p = w:GetBoneTransform(bone); local hit = Physics.Raycast(p + Vec3(0, 0.6, 0), Vec3(0, -1, 0), 2, w); assert(hit, bone .. ' has no ground under it'); return p.y - hit.Point.y, hit.Entity.Name end; local function stance() local l, lg = clearance('LeftFoot'); local r, rg = clearance('RightFoot'); assert(l > -0.02 and r > -0.02, string.format('a foot sank into the ground: %.3f %.3f', l, r)); if l < r then return l, lg end return r, rg end; local function angle(a, b) return math.deg(math.acos(math.max(-1, math.min(1, a:Normalized():Dot(b:Normalized()))))) end; local function look() local head, rotation = w:GetBoneTransform('Head'); local toOrb = Scene.FindEntityByName('Orb').WorldPosition - head; return angle(rotation * Vec3(0, 0, 1), toOrb), angle(w.Rotation * Vec3(0, 0, 1), toOrb) end; local p = w.WorldPosition; assert(p.x > -3.5 and p.x < -2, 'walker at x ' .. p.x); assert(w:IsGrounded(), 'walker is not grounded'); local h = stance(); assert(h > 0.03 and h < 0.15, 'the stance foot is not on the ground: ' .. h); assert(w:GetAnimationLayerWeight('Breathe') == 1, 'breathing layer off'); assert(w:GetIKWeight('Reach') > 0.5, 'the hand did not reach for the orb that came close'); local shoulder = w:GetBoneTransform('LeftUpperArm'); local hand = w:GetBoneTransform('LeftHand'); local d = angle(hand - shoulder, Scene.FindEntityByName('Orb').WorldPosition - shoulder); assert(d < 15, 'the reaching arm points ' .. d .. ' degrees away from the orb'); local head, body = look(); if body < 60 then assert(head < 1, string.format('head misses the orb by %.1f degrees (body %.1f)', head, body)) else assert(head < body - 60, string.format('head did not turn toward the orb: head %.1f body %.1f', head, body)) end; return string.format('x %.2f stance %.3f arm-orb %.1f deg', p.x, h, d)
